scene: Kitchen counter for afternoon snack. A cookie jar with star-shaped and round cookies sits at center; a small empty cup stands beside it. Dad stands screen-left; Child stands screen-right. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces and the jar visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child negotiates with a light, hopeful tone; Dad plays the fair judge; both end cheerful with the agreed snack.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: The cookie jar and small empty cup stand at center; Dad stands screen-left and Child screen-right with empty hands.
clips.action: Dad gestures toward the jar and the fridge while listing the options. Child holds up two fingers asking for both; Dad waves one gentle no and points toward the dinner hour.
clips.end: The jar and cup stay in place; Child's two fingers lower as he thinks.

clips.start: The jar and cup stay in place; Child's fingers lower as he thinks.
clips.action: Child pinches his fingers for one small cookie and mimes pouring milk into the cup. Dad nods slowly, agreeing. Child points at the jar and traces a small star shape in the air with one finger.
clips.end: Dad reaches one hand toward the cookie jar lid.

clips.start: Dad reaches one hand toward the cookie jar lid.
clips.action: Dad opens the jar, takes out the star cookie, and places it in Child's open hands. Child holds it up beside the cup and grins; Dad raises the small cup in a tiny toast.
clips.end: Child holds the star cookie with both hands next to the filled cup; the jar is closed again; both smile.
